layout.linkHint: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:

cash.title: Cash at the workshop
cash.text: Bring {amount} in cash and pay on the day of the workshop.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.reference: Please write “{participantName}” in the transfer description, so we know who it’s for.

online.title: Pay online
online.text: Pay {amount} by card on the secure payment page.

welcome_verify.subject: Welcome to {brand}! Please confirm your email
welcome_verify.preview: Just one small step left: confirm your email address.
welcome_verify.heading: Welcome to {brand}!
welcome_verify.intro: We’re so happy you joined us. Just one small step is left: please confirm your email address with the button below.
welcome_verify.note: If you didn’t create an account, you can simply ignore this email.

instructor_invite.subject: Welcome to {brand}: you’re now one of our instructors
instructor_invite.preview: Choose a password to open your instructor panel.
instructor_invite.heading: Welcome to the team!
instructor_invite.intro: We’re delighted to work with you. We’ve added you as an instructor at {brand}, so you can see your workshops, contracts and participants in your own panel.
instructor_invite.intro2: To get started, please choose a password for your account.
instructor_invite.note: This link is just for you, so please don’t share it. If you weren’t expecting this email, you can ignore it.

instructor_signup.subject: New instructor sign-up: {instructorName}
instructor_signup.preview: Check the details and approve them in the panel.
instructor_signup.heading: A new instructor signed up
instructor_signup.intro: {instructorName} has created an instructor account at {brand} and is waiting for your approval. Until you approve them, they can’t be chosen for a workshop.
instructor_signup.note: Check the official name, ID number and mobile in the panel before you approve.

instructor_approved.subject: You’re approved as an instructor at {brand}
instructor_approved.preview: Your profile is approved. We’ll be in touch about workshops.
instructor_approved.heading: Welcome to the team!
instructor_approved.intro: Good news: the {brand} team has approved your instructor profile. When we plan a workshop with you, your contract will be waiting in your panel.
instructor_approved.intro2: You can keep your profile and photo up to date in your panel at any time.
instructor_approved.note: If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

contract_ready.subject: Your contract for “{workshopTitle}” is ready to sign
contract_ready.preview: Read and sign it, and your workshop goes live.
contract_ready.heading: Your contract is ready
contract_ready.intro: Good news! The contract for your workshop is ready. Please read it carefully and sign it in your panel. As soon as you sign, your workshop appears on the site and registration opens.
contract_ready.note: Have a question about the contract? Please talk to us before you sign.

contract_signed.subject: {instructorName} signed the contract for “{workshopTitle}”
contract_signed.preview: The workshop is live on the site.
contract_signed.heading: Contract signed
contract_signed.intro: {instructorName} has signed the contract for “{workshopTitle}”. The workshop is live on the site.
contract_signed.note: The signed contract is saved with the workshop.

decision_due.subject: Time to decide: “{workshopTitle}”
decision_due.heading: Go or no-go?
decision_due.intro: {status, select, reached {Good news: “{workshopTitle}” has reached its minimum number of participants. Please confirm the workshop so everyone knows it’s going ahead.} other {“{workshopTitle}” hasn’t reached its minimum number of participants yet. Please decide whether to hold it or cancel it. If you cancel, every participant gets a friendly email and a full refund.}}

partner_invite.subject: {inviterName} invites you to join {brand} as a partner
partner_invite.preview: Choose a password to open the {brand} admin panel.
partner_invite.heading: Join us as a partner
partner_invite.intro: {inviterName} has invited you to become a partner at {brand}. Partners run the workshops, instructors and money together in the admin panel.
partner_invite.intro2: To accept, please choose a password for your account. This link works for one week.
partner_invite.note: This link is just for you, so please don’t share it. If you weren’t expecting this email, you can ignore it.

registration_confirmed.subject: You’re registered for “{workshopTitle}”
registration_confirmed.heading: Your place is booked!
registration_confirmed.intro: Thank you for registering! Your place in “{workshopTitle}” is confirmed. Here are the details:
registration_confirmed.note: If your plans change, you can cancel in My workshops, so someone else can take your place.

workshop_reminder.subject: See you soon at “{workshopTitle}”
workshop_reminder.heading: Your workshop is almost here
workshop_reminder.intro: Just a friendly reminder: “{workshopTitle}” is coming up soon, and we can’t wait to see you!
workshop_reminder.intro2: {ways, select, none {There’s still {amount} to pay for your registration. We’ll get in touch with you about how to pay.} one {There’s still {amount} to pay for your registration. Here’s how:} many {There’s still {amount} to pay for your registration. Choose whichever way suits you best:} other {}}
workshop_reminder.note: Please try to arrive a few minutes early, so we can all start together.

workshop_cancelled.subject: “{workshopTitle}” has been cancelled
workshop_cancelled.preview: {paid, select, yes {We’re so sorry. You’ll get your money back.} other {We’re so sorry. The workshop won’t take place.}}
workshop_cancelled.heading: We’re sorry, this workshop is cancelled
workshop_cancelled.intro: We’re really sorry to tell you that “{workshopTitle}” has been cancelled. We know you were looking forward to it.
workshop_cancelled.intro2: {paid, select, yes {You don’t need to do anything. We’ll refund {refundAmount} to you within five business days.} other {The workshop won’t take place, so please don’t come to the venue on that day. There’s nothing else you need to do.}}
workshop_cancelled.note: We’d love to see you at another workshop soon.

password_reset.subject: Reset your {brand} password
password_reset.preview: Choose a new password in just a moment.
password_reset.heading: Choose a new password
password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset your password. Tap the button below to choose a new one.
password_reset.note: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password won’t change.

member_exists.subject: You already have a {brand} account
member_exists.preview: Log in with your email, or choose a new password.
member_exists.heading: You already have an account
member_exists.intro: Someone, probably you, just tried to create a new {brand} account with this email address. Good news: you already have one!
member_exists.intro2: Just log in with your email and password. If it wasn’t you, you can simply ignore this email; nothing has changed.
member_exists.note: Forgot your password? Choose a new one here.

registration_received.subject: Your place in “{workshopTitle}” is reserved
registration_received.preview: One last step: please pay {amount} to complete your registration.
registration_received.heading: Your place is reserved!
registration_received.intro: Thank you for registering! We’ve saved a place for {participantName} in “{workshopTitle}”.
registration_received.intro2: {ways, select, none {To complete your registration, please pay {amount}. We’ll get in touch with you soon about how to pay.} one {To complete your registration, please pay {amount}. Here’s how:} other {To complete your registration, please pay {amount}. Choose whichever way suits you best:}}
registration_received.note: You can see your payment status anytime in My workshops. We’ll email you as soon as we’ve received your payment.

payment_received.subject: Thank you! We’ve received your payment for “{workshopTitle}”
payment_received.preview: Your place is confirmed. See you soon!
payment_received.heading: Your place is confirmed!
payment_received.intro: We’ve received your payment of {amount} {method, select, cash {in cash} transfer {by bank transfer} online {online} other {}} for “{workshopTitle}”. Your registration is complete, and we can’t wait to see you!
payment_received.note: If your plans change, you can cancel in My workshops. The refund you’d get is shown there before you confirm.

registration_cancelled.subject: Your registration for “{workshopTitle}” is cancelled
registration_cancelled.preview: {refund, select, full {You’ll get a full refund.} partial {You’ll get part of your payment back.} none {We’re sorry to miss you.} other {We’re sorry to miss you.}}
registration_cancelled.heading: Your registration is cancelled
registration_cancelled.intro: {by, select, us {Your registration for “{workshopTitle}” has been cancelled. If you have any questions, please get in touch with us.} other {As you asked, we’ve cancelled your registration for “{workshopTitle}”.}}
registration_cancelled.intro2: {refund, select, full {Under the cancellation terms you get a full refund: we’ll send {refundAmount} back to you within five business days.} partial {Under the cancellation terms you get {refundPercent, number}% of your payment back: we’ll send {refundAmount} back to you within five business days.} none {Under the cancellation terms, a cancellation less than 24 hours before the start can’t be refunded. We’re sorry.} other {You hadn’t paid yet, so there’s nothing else to do.}}
registration_cancelled.note: We’d love to see you at another workshop soon.

refund_due.subject: Refund to pay: {participantName}, “{workshopTitle}”
refund_due.heading: A refund needs paying
refund_due.intro: {participantName} cancelled their registration for “{workshopTitle}”. Under the terms, {amount} needs to be paid back.
refund_due.intro2: Please pay it back within five business days, then mark it as refunded in the refunds list.

refund_sent.subject: Your refund for “{workshopTitle}” is on its way
refund_sent.heading: Your refund has been sent
refund_sent.intro: We’ve paid {amount} back to you for “{workshopTitle}”. Depending on your bank, it may take a few days to show in your account.
refund_sent.note: If you have any questions, please get in touch with us.
